metric_name: Assets achieving an exposure reduction to known health risks
context_text: Have all of our businesses identify at least one critical health hazard material to their business and demonstrate a year-on-year reduction of exposure to that hazard.；14 of our assets across Rio Tinto achieved an exposure reduction to known health risks (airborne contaminants and noise).
